comments.value: In the meantime, I've found that anytime you want to compare displayName strings, it's sometimes safer and avoids issues if you convert the strings to be compared to hash codes using string.GetHashCode()
the problem is that same client users can spoof the displayname and this is not funny for an admin pannel script
Bump, pushing for this for a more accurate way to tell which player is who and to avoid the common issue with special character names breaking playerlisting.

I don't agree with this.  This is a slippery slope 

While the beneficial side is allowing an online white listed area ..

It can also be abused for malicious intent 

VrChat ToS says that creating a white list area is okay but maintaining a blacklist, especially when it prevents the user from enjoying the world that is publicly released can be done.

Imagine that you're friends with a VrChat game world creator.  You guys had a stupid falling out that had nothing to do with the game 

Some of your friends asked to join you to your former friends game world to have fun 

You accept and enter the world.  Udon reads your username and insta teleports you to a blocked area 

While this may not prevent them from entering the world, this essentially creates a blacklist and punishment that a world creator that made a public world, can whimsically decide who can and can enter their public world 

It's a slippery slope

@{68b7a5c7ce2ca2b520d2e571|full_name}  the behavior you mentioned already happens in some club worlds without access to the userID, this would not change that behavior, this is for a more accurate reading of playerlisting.

Why is this not implemented still?

We can already create filter lists for admin panels, vips, etc.. so this is not the concern.

We NEED this implemented so cheaters wont get access to admin panels or vip features by spoofing display name.

@{68b7a5c7ce2ca2b520d2e571|full_name} It is against vrchat TOS to do exactly that. and vrchat is VERY strict on this as it will get you banned for months the moment you add it to your world. it is possible to do it without udon already, but not with udon. Reasons to do this with udon is things like blacklisting users who use clients or cheat. while cheating and using a client in a single person game is fine, multi-player is not ok.

This would be nice for whitelisting, because as far as I know, the only way that is exposed to Udon for identifying players is the display name, but if the player changed their display name, that won't work for them anymore until the whitelist is updated. Unless you use some kind of Persistance to fix this issue, there is no other workaround with that. Though this could be a problem for Blacklisting as someone else also pointed out, this could be a definitive way to ensure a player doesn't lose access to areas, like from supporting a creators patreon to access special areas, or whitelisted features like a infinite ammo in weapons in game worlds.

details: For UDON admin interfaces or whitelisted areas  etc. it would be great to have GetUserID or something like that exposed, It's been a real struggle with people with special characters in their display name, UserIDs would make the process so much cleaner, and more reliable
title: Allow us to get UserID of a VRCPlayer
